title: 第一章 开局就是噩梦级世界第二章 突飞猛进
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
“这里是？”
林阳迷迷糊糊的睁开了眼睛，他发现自己正躺在一张木床上身上盖着一张不知名的兽皮，不大的房间内随意摆放着弓箭长矛。
刚想翻身下床，出门看看自己究竟来到了哪里，就感觉到了浑身上下剧痛无比，就好像被车辆碾压过似的。
林阳倒吸了口冷气，若不是自小忍耐力就不同寻常，换成常人赶上这种疼痛恐怕早就大叫出声。他努力的回想自己怎么会变成这个样子的，可是想了半天都只记得自己一如既往的上床睡觉，结果一觉醒来就出现在了这里。
这时，房门被推开，一个身着兽皮衣物的中年人走了进来。
中年人看到清醒的林阳微微一愣，开口道：“年轻人你醒了啊？你都已经昏迷一天了。”
明明兽皮中年的话语是一种林阳不曾接触过的语言，但是林阳却发现自己可以听懂。
“我都已经昏迷一天了吗？这里是哪里？”林阳疑惑的看向中年，他不知道中年人能不能听懂普通话，也许对方听到的话语在未知原因影响下也是他自身所使用的语种？
“对，村子的狩猎队在外面发现了昏迷的你，当时你身上除了一件裤布外什么都没有，为了你的安全着想，就把你带回了村子。”
经过和中年人的交流，林阳渐渐清楚了自己现在所处的是什么地方了。
就跟他猜测的一样穿越了，现在所在的这个村庄叫做朱村，村子有一千多户人家，名字取自村子的守护神按照中年人说法是祭灵的蜘蛛谐音。
村庄所处雷州，按古代流传下来的说法，雷州这样的大洲，世界上约莫有三千州之多。
祭灵，三千道州……
等中年人离去，林阳也都摸清了现在是什么情况。
他不止穿越了，还穿越到了完美世界这本小说中，又被书友戏称一个人的遮天。并且直接穿越到了上界三千道州之一的雷州上。这个朱村就是石昊上界后涅盘所在的地方。
“系统。”
林阳抱着试试的想法在心里默念着。毕竟穿越到小说世界也许是意外，不过这个自带的翻译功能，肯定是金手指的效果，什么小塔、镜子、小树什么的。而在穿越小说中出现最多的就是系统了，所以林阳就从这个开始试起来。
果不其然，林阳内心刚刚呼唤结束，他就看见眼前出现一行行的数据。
任务：无
历练点：0

倒计时：28天
林阳看到这三行数据，自然而然的就明白了其代表了什么意思。在满足了某些条件时，这个“系统”会发布任务，完成任务会获得历练点，失败则无法得到历练点，除此之外并无抹杀之类的惩罚。
历练点可以用来提升自身修为境界，学习技能提升熟练程度，除了完成任务得到历练点外，还可以通过击杀强度和自身相差无几的生命体获取。
content_en:
"Is this here?"
Lin Yang opened his eyes drowsily and found that he was lying on a wooden bed covered with an unknown animal skin. Bows, arrows and spears were randomly placed in the small room.
Just as he was about to get out of bed and go out to see where he had come, he felt a sharp pain all over his body, as if he had been run over by a vehicle.
Lin Yang sucked in a breath of cold air. If his endurance hadn't been unusual since he was a child, a normal person would have screamed if he encountered this kind of pain. He tried hard to recall how he became like this, but after thinking for a long time, he only remembered that he went to bed as usual, and ended up here when he woke up.
At this time, the door was pushed open, and a middle-aged man wearing animal skin clothes walked in.
The middle-aged man was slightly startled when he saw Lin Yang who was awake, and said, "Young man, are you awake? You've been in a coma for a day."
It was obvious that the middle-aged animal skin's words were a language that Lin Yang had never been exposed to before, but Lin Yang found that he could understand it.
"Have I been unconscious for a day? Where is this place?" Lin Yang looked at the middle-aged man in confusion. He didn't know if the middle-aged man could understand Mandarin. Maybe the words the other party heard were also the language he used due to unknown reasons?
"Yes, the village's hunting team found you unconscious outside. At that time, you were wearing nothing but a piece of trousers. For your safety, they took you back to the village."
After communicating with the middle-aged man, Lin Yang gradually understood where he was now.
Just as he guessed, he traveled through time. The village he is in now is called Zhucun. There are more than a thousand households in the village. The name is taken from the patron saint of the village. According to middle-aged people, it is a homonym for spider for worshiping spirits.
The village is located in Leizhou. According to legend passed down from ancient times, there are about three thousand states in the world like Leizhou.
Sacrificing spirits, three thousand states...
After the middle-aged man left, Lin Yang also figured out what was going on now.
Not only did he travel through time, but he also traveled through time in the novel Perfect World, and was jokingly called one person's covering the sky by book friends. And he traveled directly to Leizhou, one of the three thousand states in the upper realm. This Zhucun is where Shi Hao went to Nirvana after going to the upper realm.
"System."
Lin Yang thought to himself with the idea of giving it a try. After all, it may be an accident to travel to the world of novels, but the built-in translation function must be the effect of golden fingers, such as small towers, mirrors, small trees, etc. The most common thing in time travel novels is the system, so Lin Yang started to try it out.
Sure enough, just as Lin Yang finished calling out in his heart, he saw rows of data appearing in front of him.
Task: None
Experience points: 0
Countdown: 28 days
When Lin Yang saw these three lines of data, he naturally understood what they meant. When certain conditions are met, this "system" will issue tasks. If you complete the task, you will get experience points. If you fail, you will not get experience points. Otherwise, there is no penalty such as erasure.
Experience points can be used to improve one's own cultivation level, learn skills and improve proficiency. In addition to gaining experience points by completing tasks, they can also be obtained by killing life forms whose strength is almost the same as one's own.
